capabilities: Publish the current note to a web page from the ribbon, right-click menu, or command palette
Update an existing share without changing its URL
Copy the share link to the clipboard
Upload images referenced in the shared note
Set 1-day or 7-day expiration for shared links
disambiguation: Not an Obsidian Publish replacement; it shares individual notes to an author-run server with expiring links.
extras: API tokens are not publicly available; users must contact the author by WeChat or email to obtain one, which limits usability.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish a single note as a private, expiring web link without setting up a publishing service.
summary: Publishing plugin that shares individual notes to a self-hosted web page via one click, with image upload, link expiration, and share syncing.
